steps.content: Days are passing by, living this lie, Not knowing what we're looking for. Gray, these walls are gray and there's no sky. There is no hope, there is no soar. I know somewhere there must be more.

The Blue Rain pours down once a month, and it has been drizzling today. The soaked clothes stick to the body, and the icy water seeps into the wounds. Before the pain sets in, Mania is already reacting.

Angell leans against a lamp post in the narrow alley. Despite the surrounding silence, the intense stimulation to her senses completely overwhelms the music in her headphones. She looks down to pause the player, then turns her gaze to the dark alley.
From the darkness, a man emerges, followed by an attendant holding an umbrella for him. Several more pairs of eyes lurk in the shadows behind him.

steps.speaker: Gang Leader
steps.content: You're punctual, Angell, as expected of the top hitman on the dark web.

steps.speaker: Gang Leader
steps.content: But it seems you didn't bring what I wanted.
Angell knows him well—he's a middleman hidden within Syndicate. She has taken several big orders from him. Not too bad as a client.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: There are loads after him, just having my pick here.
steps.female_content: There are loads after her, just having my pick here.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: You know, see who they are, what they can offer, and just how much they want his life.
steps.female_content: You know, see who they are, what they can offer, and just how much they want her life.

steps.speaker: Gang Leader
steps.content: Heh, silent killer is more your style, Angell. Cut the crap.

steps.speaker: Gang Leader
steps.content: Those who came to you asking for that person all got killed, right? Sounds like the Top Hitman's been baiting her clients... Are you trying to pull that same trick on me?

The man's expression darkens, and heavy footsteps echo behind him. Thugs step out from the darkness, some of them blocking her escape route, while countless guns from the surrounding buildings take aim at their only target—Angell is surrounded.
The first to step out of the crowd are two heavily modified thugs. Blue Rain ignites their marks of Mania; they are Sinners.

steps.speaker: Miguel
steps.content: Hehehe, is this the one? I can kill her in any way I want as long as she's dead?

steps.speaker: Melanie
steps.content: Shut up, Miguel. Show some respect to the Top Hitman. She'll do us a huge favor soon.

steps.speaker: Melanie
steps.content: Sorry, ”Angel”. The newbies here need some achievements to prove themselves. I'm just trying to beef up my resume here.

steps.speaker: Melanie
steps.content: The worth of a hitman is measured by the heads they collect, and yours is the top prize. As the number one hitman on the dark web, you know how it is, right?
Angell recognizes them—they're all hitmen on the dark web. With them securing more and more gigs lately, they are on the brink of overtaking Angell in the system rankings.

Chasing after the "number one" title is nothing weird. It's actually no different from how she enjoys red bean soup and keeping goldfish. People living on the edge of the world tend to have their own quirks.
But their client pays no mind to these matters, his cunning, vulture-like gaze is fixed on Angell.

steps.speaker: Gang Leader
steps.content: Letting the target escape, then coming back to point your blade at your old clients...

steps.speaker: Gang Leader
steps.content: Is it for the money? How much did the Bureau offer you? Or were you charmed by that Chief? Heh... None of these sounds like it.
The man laughed, his expression a mix of anger and mockery. Angell likes this familiar look; she even had to thank everyone here.
It's been a long time since she felt this shaken. Thanks to them, Angell finally sees her place and makes peace with her choices.

steps.speaker: Gang Leader
steps.content: You've always wanted to break free from the dark web, always fantasizing about returning to the "normal" side of the world. Do you think he can help you, or did he promise you?
steps.female_content: You've always wanted to break free from the dark web, always fantasizing about returning to the "normal" side of the world. Do you think she can help you, or did she promise you?

steps.speaker: Gang Leader
steps.content: Forget it. He can't even protect himself, let alone you. There are plenty out there who want him dead, hired or not. He's crossed lines he shouldn't have. It's only a matter of time before he's killed.
steps.female_content: Forget it. She can't even protect herself, let alone you. There are plenty out there who want her dead, hired or not. She's crossed lines she shouldn't have. It's only a matter of time before she's killed.

steps.speaker: Gang Leader
steps.content: And you have no idea what you're up against.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: That's not true. I chose this side of the world, so of course, I'll do my job.

steps.speaker: Gang Leader
steps.content: Doing your job means betraying your client?

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: No. I don't take on many gigs, but I make sure to complete the ones I do.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: Out of all the assassination jobs, only the one I took wasn't about killing the Chief of MBCC. It was to "kidnap and hold" until delivery.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: I followed those exact orders, and you can check the records. Now that the job has expired, as compensation for the lost payment, I can do whatever I want with the "goods." Everything is by the book, even the system has given me a good review.

steps.speaker: Gang Leader
steps.content: ...Kidnap? That's not possible. I know Carnivore was your client. They've been holding a grudge after what happened in Syndicate, and they only want the Chief dead.

steps.speaker: Gang Leader
steps.content: Did you hack the dark web and alter the job details?!

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: I know nothing about that. I'm just a regular hitman who follows orders; tech is not my thing.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: But I wouldn't mind if someone managed to hack the dark web and mess with that job.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: There are others on the dark web trying to keep him alive. That's good.
steps.female_content: There are others on the dark web trying to keep her alive. That's good.

steps.content: The man's expression darkens, while Angell's lips slowly curl into a smile, her mood visibly brightening.
The sadness from parting slowly eases. She's always been the type to make a choice and never look back. For someone accustomed to farewells, being sentimental is pointless.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: Since I've chosen to live on the dark web, I will respect the rules here.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: But you do surprise me, though. Why are you so angry? You know this world far better than I do.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: On this side of the world, what's the point of morals and credibility?
Her smile widens as she turns and walks towards the man. The rain washes over her, clearing the accumulated blood from several rounds of killing and leaving a red puddle under her feet.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: I kinda have some principles, but none of you show respect to that.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: ...You want me to kill those you can't kill. You just need this blade.
She slowly draws her blade, murderous malice awakening her senses. A few people around her recoil. That's right, this is the kind of distance she is familiar with.
There's nothing scary about malice. Under the night sky, she has always been the one who instills fear in everyone.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: Well, I don't mind proving how sharp my blade is once again. Let's see how many gangsters and Sinners it can take down in one day. After today, only more would want to use it.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: I'm a hitman on the dark web, after all. I know the drill.
She's overexerted herself. Blue Rain has arrived as expected. I made sure to bring enough people—I've hired hitmen and modified Sinners, all stronger than her. I'm well-prepared!
The man thinks to himself, but overwhelmed by the intense malice emanating from Angell, he involuntarily steps back.

steps.speaker: Gang Leader
steps.content: Move it! What are you waiting for?!

steps.speaker: Miguel
steps.content: It's my turn! My turn!
With a flash, one of his ears flies off. Angell gives her blade a shake and resumes the music.
The gentle, soothing music begins again. There's too much stimulation during work, a tune gives her just enough time to calm the restlessness in her heart.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: Don't let the dead do the talking. I just want to speak with you.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: After this song, answer my questions: Who gave you the gig? Who asked you to kill Chief?
